jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: first review board for Sword and Fire (剑与火), a landscape mobile isometric action RPG. Create ONE premium game VFX art direction board, wide landscape about 2400x1600, a clean 2x2 grid of four equally large gameplay-scale action scenes.
Reference image is ONLY a style/material reference: existing approved direction for steel, physical arrow, continuous fire comet and coherent blue-white branching lightning. Reinterpret with better weight and readability; do not copy old labels or damage geometry.
Presentation: matte very dark brown margins, restrained antique gold thin dividers, clean Simplified Chinese titles. Title exactly “四职业技能特效 · 首版方向稿”. Small footer exactly “概念设计 · 待审 · 尚未实现”. Each panel should be mostly art (not paragraphs). Same muted realistic brown stone battlefield, same elevated isometric camera, same small white-haired male adventurer in burgundy brown coat with weapon appropriate to class, several dark armored enemies. This is grounded game art, not anime, not cinematic close-ups. Keep characters/feet recognizable. Effects are substantial and beautiful but do not flood the screen or obscure all enemies.
Top left title “战士｜钢刃重击”. Adventurer making a heavy short melee sword slash into ONE armored opponent, strong ivory steel crescent with a fine warm gold edge, a broad transient sheet showing the physical blade swing, concentrated contact sparks, restrained earth chips. It must feel metallic with momentum, NOT flame, not a remote laser, not a giant circular magic spell. One main trail with a faint earlier trail, not three simultaneous damage hits.
Top right title “弓系｜穿云与箭阵”. Adventurer with visible bow at lower left, a sharply readable physical arrow with ivory-gold arrowhead and a clean directional short wind sheath hitting one opponent; behind and toward the upper right include a small separate unobtrusive ultimate vignette of a disciplined volley of straight distinct arrows toward several enemies. Separate arrows from dust; NO wavy retargeting ribbon, NO generic beam, NO random rain of sparkling lines.
Bottom left title “火系｜陨星天坠 · 终极”. This must be the most spectacular panel: one large incoming diagonal meteor COMET above a circular ground impact point, continuous bright rounded fire head surrounded by volumetric orange-red curling flames and a long tapering tail, NO exposed rock. A short heavy low outward curling impact fire crown with compact hot core, in saturated deep orange/red and a little warm white. A fully patterned magic circle on the ground with radial flame filigree across the whole disk, seen beneath the comet, translucent ground readable. Main meteor occupies only the designated area, not whole panel. No black smoke. Express massive weight and one main impact, not scattered small fireballs.
Bottom right title “雷系｜连贯雷网”. Adventurer casting into an enemy group, a VERY STRONG continuous blue-white lightning trunk with a clearly visible white core and saturated electric blue envelope, splits into 3-5 deliberate thick connected branches spreading as a horizontal sheet through the enemy area, a few short subordinate branches and compact hit nodes. Match reference lightning identity but visibly increase trunk visual weight ~2x. Make hierarchy obvious: main trunk > secondary branches > tiny accents. NO confetti, NO countless thin disconnected electric scratches, NO blurry blue fog, NO generic vertical laser.
Do not show cooldown numbers, damage numbers, level multipliers, numerical range, or imply redesigned gameplay stats. No HUD buttons on this board. This is a visual direction proposal, not finished implementation. Ensure Chinese text is accurate and legible.

Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high fidelity PLAYER circular skill targeting decal and state design sheet for 剑与火, first proposal only. Create one wide landscape board about 2400x1600. Dark warm brown design board, restrained antique gold typography and dividers, realistic muted stone-ground preview tiles. Match the supplied prior direction reference: fire saturated deep orange-red with small hot core, thunder blue-white coherent branching, bow ivory champagne physical weapon identity. These are semi-transparent luminous ground decals, not solid medallions, not jewelry, not opaque UI buttons.
Header exact Simplified Chinese “技能范围圈 · 全盘纹样设计”. Small subtitle “纹样表达效果，外圈标明边界”. Footer “玩家瞄准概念 · 待审 · 尚未实现”.
TOP TWO THIRDS: three equal large square study tiles side by side, all circular in TOP-DOWN view. Each disc about 470px wide, same ground texture behind. Important: detailed purposeful linework must populate the ENTIRE interior from center to border, not just a decorated rim and an empty center. At the same time, empty space BETWEEN lines stays transparent, so stone grain remains fully visible. Line weights designed for mobile, 3 levels of hierarchy (clear narrow perimeter, medium main structure, fine interior pattern); no solid colored disc fill, no huge bloom, no alphabetic pseudo-runes or pentagrams.
Left tile label exactly “陨石｜焚星坠落 · 终极”. One precise thin circular warm ivory boundary, a narrow inner ring of short engraved rune-like nonalphabetic ticks, six radial connected curling flame channels that sweep from center through ALL sectors, interlocking finer cinder-vein filigree fills each sector, central meteor impact sigil composed of compact sun core and short tapering flame fingers. Pattern should look like a magical molten flame flow field describing explosive outward force, not a generic geometric mandala or flower. Hottest amber lines near center, orange-red branches farther out, white-gold actual boundary. Dense design spans the whole disk; roughly two thirds of disk remains open between tracery lines. Ground not blackened. Bright enough to see on LIGHT stone.
Middle tile label exactly “雷系｜连锁搜索范围”. Precise circular champagne-white boundary, blue-white continuous branching discharge channels across the entire disc from a small offset core to distinct nodes, angular irregular arcs in multiple sectors, stronger trunks and weaker subordinate lines, coherent field rather than confetti. The interior visual must be calmer than the ACTUAL attack lightning, because this is a targeting preview. Little closed knot markers signify potential link points, no promises of every enemy being hit. No thick opaque blue fill or many floating particles.
Right tile label exactly “弓系｜缚足陷阱”. Same true circular boundary, ivory-gold interlaced binding knot work across the WHOLE disc, directional arrowhead engravings and braided wind lines meeting at a compact central trap/knot sigil, clear binding restraint identity. Geometric arrow knots, not flames, not lightning, not green plants. Medium linework good at small mobile size.
BOTTOM THIRD: a clean left-to-right FOUR-STEP meteor skill ground decal lifecycle storyboard. Four equal stone tiles in matching isometric view, each same projected ellipse size and same simple dark-armored enemy standing inside with silhouette/feet visible. Step1 exact label “瞄准”: entire fire pattern present but low glow, narrow readable outer boundary. Step2 “锁定”: SAME circle and radius, complete pattern brightens along existing channels toward center, brief compact pulse, no radius expansion. Step3 “命中”: small concentrated low fire crown at center and warm impact light, not tall wall of fire, perimeter begins to fade, ground and enemy still legible. Step4 “消散”: only very faint partial ember lines, most stone visible, no persistent targeting rim. Do NOT include numerical timings or damage/radius stats. Above small 4-step row label “陨石施放前后 · 状态分层”.
At bottom right include a small blocked-state stamp example: broken outer ring + clear X symbol + text exactly “不可施放”; use muted red and shape change together, not color alone.
This is not enemy attack telegraph art. No enemy warning overlays, no HUD relocation, no gameplay stats, no skill icon buttons. Professional game UI/VFX style study, sharp beautiful original engraved patterns, excellent visual hierarchy and Chinese text accuracy.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: Image 1, the existing four-panel VFX direction board. Image 2 is ONLY the reference for circular ground decal motifs; do not copy its layout.
Make exactly these targeted final corrections, preserving the target's 2x2 composition, battlefield, characters, steel sword slash, thick connected blue-white lightning, fire comet body, title, dark gold frames, and footer:
1) In the bottom-left fire panel, replace the existing broad petal/compass-shaped ground magic circle with the LEFT fire-vein decal from Image 2: precise single thin circular boundary seen as a ground-perspective ellipse, connected curling radial fire channels from a compact central sun core, finer branching cinder-vein filigree distributed THROUGHOUT all sectors. NO remaining large petal or compass geometry. Orange-red engraved lines; ground clearly visible between lines. Fit exactly the same footprint as the old circle. Keep incoming comet and low impact flames unchanged and in front of this decal.
2) Bottom-left panel title must read exactly “火系｜焚星坠落 · 终极”. Keep its existing typography and location. Do not rename other skills.
3) In the top-right bow panel, make the foreground main projectile clearly a PHYSICAL arrow: a crisp metal arrowhead, a visible dark wooden shaft and small fletching, with a short, restrained ivory wind sheath and much fainter previous path. Reduce the main projectile's luminous beam/ribbon quality. Keep the small distant volley vignette as distinct straight arrows. Do not alter character positions or add extra characters.
Output one finished high quality board, same aspect ratio. All other pixels/design intentions should remain as close to Image 1 as possible. Preserve all Chinese text except the corrected bottom-left title.

Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a revised high-quality game skill ground-circle design board, WIDE PANORAMIC landscape about 2400x1000. This is a response to specific user feedback: the reference's dense fine veins are too intricate, but replacing them with repeated little flame/bolt icons was far too simplistic and repetitive. Find the correct middle ground: one coherent designed elemental pattern per circle, medium complexity, strong thick graphic linework, no stamp repetitions.
Reference is ONLY the old detailed motif direction to simplify. Do NOT copy its layout, color or tiny crack detail.
All artwork and typography MUST be strictly neutral grayscale (white, gray, charcoal), no orange, blue, gold or other hues. Range decals have no glow or solid disc fill. The underlying neutral gray stone ground stays clearly visible between strokes. This is tasteful grounded fantasy game UI, not a coloring book, not clip art, not a UI badge.
Layout: restrained charcoal board, one short header “技能范围圈 · 连贯纹样稿”, subtitle “双层外圈 · 粗线条 · 单色示意”. Below, THREE LARGE equal TOP-DOWN circles side by side. Each circle about 520px diameter on the same neutral gray rough stone ground tile, with text above. No additional lifecycle rows or duplicate examples. Footer “静态设计候选 · 尚未实现”.
Every circle has EXACTLY TWO CLEAN CONCENTRIC OUTLINE RINGS: distinct outer and inner ring, narrow clean empty gap between them, 6px outer stroke and 4px inner stroke at 520px circle size. No rune ticks, dots, scallops, compass marks or little decorative dashes between rings.
Circle 1 heading “陨石｜火焰旋流”. Interior is ONE continuous, custom asymmetrical fire-flow sigil covering most of the disc. A compact central impact core joins FOUR to SIX broad sweeping flame channels, each with a different natural curve and length, expanding diagonally and curling toward inner boundary. Give channels large tapering tips, intentional open negative-space pockets and a few broad contour strokes suggesting rolling flame. It should resemble the existing fire-vein field after removing ALL tiny crack tributaries and thickening the handful of primary channels. Do not draw seven isolated flame icons, repeated teardrops, a regular flower/mandala, or a single tiny flame in the middle. One connected expressive ground pattern, with strong silhouette and enough structure across entire disc.
Circle 2 heading “雷系｜分叉电场”. Interior is ONE coherent large lightning structure: a bold irregular zigzag trunk crosses the disc on a diagonal, splitting into three deliberate secondary branches with different direction, spacing and length. A few angular large negative-space channels compose a whole-disc field. Main lines about 7-10px wide, secondary 5px; no tiny tertiary sparks, micro-scratches, repeated lightning-bolt icons, dense electrical spiderweb, or random short disconnected segments. Asymmetry and hierarchy, not repeated geometry. All gray-white, no blue.
Circle 3 heading “陷阱｜束缚结纹”. Interior is ONE cohesive interlocking restraint pattern spanning the disc: three broad interwoven continuous strands form a large central binding knot and extend outward in different directions toward the inner circle, with a few clear angular anchor turns and open spaces. Deliberate woven over/under topology; no chain-link icon stamps, rows of repeated links, arrows tiled around a circle, delicate Celtic micro-detail or floral pattern. Thick confident strokes, simple readable topology with restrained medium complexity.
The pattern linework must feel designed and materially richer than a few repeated pictograms, while dramatically simpler and coarser than the detailed reference. TWO rings remain very clearly separated from interior texture in all three circles. Preserve generous transparency between strokes. No characters, no HUD, no stats, no decorative fantasy lettering.

Use case: ui-mockup.
Create the revised final fantasy RPG range-circle design sheet for 剑与火. Reference image shows the desired COHERENT INTERIOR PATTERN approach (not repeating pictograms). Keep that middle level of complexity but apply the latest user corrections below.
Output one polished 2x2 FOUR-CLASS board, landscape about 2000x1500, matte dark brown margins, neutral realistic brown stone ground tiles. Header exactly “四职业技能范围圈 · 双环纹样稿”. Subtitle “沿用淡金色 · 粗纹样 · 职业纹带”. Footer “静态设计候选 · 尚未实现”.
COLOR: restore the SAME existing champagne gold range-indicator palette across ALL FOUR classes: main muted antique pale gold #C2AA79, pale champagne #E4D3B0, restrained warm highlight #FFF5DC, darker stroke #AA8F5B. These are warm GOLD indicators, NOT white, NOT grayscale. No class-specific red, orange or blue color. Neutral warm gold keeps current game's targeting identity. Subtle translucency and natural stone visible in the gaps. Avoid strong bloom or shiny 3D metal relief. These are flat ground graphics, not solid medallions.
GEOMETRY: each class has TWO distinct concentric circular boundary lines. At 500px disc diameter, outer ring stroke about5px, inner ring about4px, with a roughly24px-wide ANNULAR BAND between them. User now explicitly wants characteristic decoration BETWEEN the two rings. Put the class-specific simple continuous engraving INTO THIS BAND, neither empty band nor floating exterior decorations. The band carving should have clear thick 3-5px strokes, a few open gaps for breathing room; do not cram dozens of micro runes, little ticks or tiny dots.
All interiors: use ONE cohesive bespoke whole-disc elemental sigil with clear strong main forms about7-12px wide and a few 4-6px supporting contours. Enough designed texture to feel rich, but no fine crack filigree, no dense spiderweb, no identical icon stamps, no regular flower/petal mandala. The original reference's central fire-flow, coherent lightning branching and woven knot are the basis. Do not arrange repeated tiny flame/bolt/link icons.
TOP LEFT title “战士｜刃刻与破阵”.
Interior: one dynamic unified steel-swing/earth-cleave sigil, a central sharp diagonal blade cut intersects two different broad swept blade arcs and a few large angular fracture facets spanning disk, strong martial geometry and asymmetry, not a sword icon pasted seven times.
BETWEEN THE RINGS: a continuous martial engraved band of slanted blade chamfers, short bevel facets and angular joined cuts. Recognizable metal/weapon carving, coarse enough for mobile, not leaf/flame/bolt motifs.
TOP RIGHT title “弓系｜箭羽与束缚”.
Interior: a cohesive large restraint knot formed by three broad interwoven angular/ribbon-like paths, subtle arrowhead endings and feathered directional cuts, one connected design, much transparent open ground. Do not fill ribbons opaquely; keep them light champagne linework with a few broad soft supporting strokes.
BETWEEN THE RINGS: a continuous woven feather/lacing band with clear angled arrow-feather rhythm and a few binding crossings. Different from warrior's hard cuts and different from repeated chain-link icon stamps.
BOTTOM LEFT title “火系｜卷焰与陨星”.
Interior: adapt reference fire circle into one sweeping asymmetrical vortex of about five broad connected fire channels flowing out from a compact impact core, unique curled tapering tips and large open pockets. Keep only main flame forms and a few medium contours, remove tiny extra branches. Main motif in the same GOLD palette, not orange flame color.
BETWEEN THE RINGS: a clear coarse continuous rolling-flame scroll with tapered flame crests that flow around circumference, no tiny fire pictogram stamps, not uniform scallops.
BOTTOM RIGHT title “雷系｜折纹与电场”.
Interior: one bold zigzag trunk spreads diagonally across the disk, splits into three deliberate medium-weight branches with different lengths and angles, creating a coherent field. Some large angular negative-space channels but no tertiary fine sparks. Same GOLD palette, not blue-white lightning color.
BETWEEN THE RINGS: a continuous angular electric meander engraved band, joined zigzag turns with a few branching junctions and deliberate openings; do not tile discrete lightning bolt icons.
Make rings and band decoration visually separated from interior field in all panels. Circle motifs are range-indicator vocabulary proposals only; do not show combat damage or claim all warrior attacks are circular. No numerical dimensions, stats, cooldowns, characters, HUD or implementation claims. Elegant clear Simplified Chinese labels.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Image 1 is the edit target: four-panel attack VFX concept board. Image 2 is the FINAL ground range-indicator reference.
Update ONLY the ground circle in the bottom-left fire panel of Image 1. Completely remove its old thin orange branching-crack circle. At the SAME footprint, replace it with the exact bottom-left FIRE pattern from Image 2, projected into the same ground ellipse: two clearly separate concentric circular borders, with the continuous rolling flame-scroll decoration BETWEEN THE TWO RINGS; inside, one coherent asymmetrical sweeping fire-flow sigil of broad connected curled flame channels. Use the existing game's PALE CHAMPAGNE GOLD palette for all indicator linework (#C2AA79, #E4D3B0, restrained #FFF5DC highlights). It is NOT white, and not orange. Translucent lines reveal the ground, no opaque disc fill, no bright glow, no fine crack branches or tiny rune ticks. Do NOT draw repeated isolated flame icons. Circle border, decorated band and interior sigil must all match the bottom-left reference motif.
Keep the incoming continuous orange-red comet and its low contact fire in Image 1 unchanged, in front of the indicator. Keep every other panel, character, steel slash, physical arrow, blue-white lightning, framing and Chinese text unchanged. Bottom-left title stays exactly “火系｜焚星坠落 · 终极”. This is a targeted static concept correction, not a new composition.

Use case: background-extraction and precise-object-edit.
Asset: transparent review-only ground range decal.
Reference image is the final four-class circle board. Extract/recreate ONLY the BOTTOM-LEFT FIRE CIRCLE from that reference as a clean standalone top-down circular decal.
It must have TWO clean concentric gold boundary rings, a rolling-flame scroll ornamental band BETWEEN the two rings, and one coherent sweeping fire-flow sigil in the interior. Match the broad connected curved flame channels and tapering ends in the reference. No repeated little icon stamps. Preserve the motif identity and proportions. Coarse clear linework, moderate complexity.
Output a square image with the full complete circle centered and a small transparent margin. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background outside AND between ALL lines, including every interior negative space. Absolutely NO ground, stone texture, dark disc, drop shadow, baked rectangular background, lettering, headings or footer. Keep gaps between strokes clean.
Use FLAT pale antique champagne gold from the existing palette (#C2AA79 main, #E4D3B0 restrained lighter edges). Not white, not orange. No metallic texture, no glitter, no photoreal shading, no noisy distressed edges, no bloom or blur. Uniform crisp flat graphic fill/linework, not chunky thick opaque filled areas: most of the disk should be transparent. The annular pattern should clearly fit BETWEEN the two border lines rather than merging into a solid thick border. This is a clean isolated decal derivative for a static game UI mockup, not an implemented game resource.
